BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to institutional chaplains; and amending RCW72.01.210.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 72.01.210 and 1993 c 281 s 62 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of corrections shall appoint fulltime and parttimechaplains for the state correctional institutions as is necessary tomeet the religious needs for convicted felons((; and)), and for othercustodial and correctional institutions under his or her control. Theparttime chaplains are to be considered employees of the department ofcorrections with all the rights and responsibilities accorded employeesunder chapter 41.06 RCW as they relate to indemnification and defensefor matters arising from acts while the employee was acting within thescope of his or her employment or duties. The chaplains appointedunder this section are under the direct authority of a chaplaindesignated as the manager of religious programs within the departmentof corrections. The secretary of social and health services shallappoint chaplains for the correctional institutions for juveniles founddelinquent by the juvenile courts((;)), and ((the secretary of p. 1 SB 6253corrections and the secretary of social and health services shallappoint one or more chaplains)) for other custodial, correctional, andmental institutions under ((their)) his or her control. The chaplains((so)) appointed under this section shall have the qualificationsconsistent with community standards of the given faith group to whichthe chaplain belongs and shall be compensated in an amount, as shallhereafter be recommended by the departments and approved by theWashington personnel resources board. The department of correctionsand the department of social and health services shall requirechaplains appointed under this section to participate in training tothe extent the training is necessary and appropriate to enable thechaplain to fulfill his or her duties as a chaplain.
